metadata.title: Contact Risein AI
metadata.description: Contact Risein AI about a free workflow audit, AI automation, bookkeeping systems, TaLi SmartBookkeeper, PersonaLab AI or a custom business solution.

hero.title: Tell us what is slowing your business down.
hero.description: Request a free workflow audit, discuss one of our products or explain the business process you want to improve.

details.title: Start with the problem. We will help you identify the right next step.
details.description: You do not need to understand AI or automation before contacting us. Simply describe what takes too much time, causes errors or creates unnecessary work.

practical.title: Practical recommendations
practical.description: We focus on realistic systems that match your actual workflow and resources.

response.title: Clear response
response.description: We will review your enquiry and respond with an appropriate next step.

clear.title: No technical language required
clear.description: Explain the problem in simple words and we will help structure the solution.

details.emailDescription: You can also contact us directly at:
details.privacy: Your information will only be used to respond to your enquiry.

placeholders.name: Enter your full name
placeholders.message: Describe the process, problem or idea you would like to discuss.

form.success: Thank you. Your enquiry has been sent successfully. We will respond as soon as possible.
form.privacy: Your information will only be used to review and respond to your enquiry.

errors.required: Please complete your name, email address and message.
errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.messageTooShort: Please provide at least 10 characters in your message.
errors.submit: We could not send your enquiry. Please try again.

expectation.title: What happens next?
expectation.description: We review the information you provide, identify the most suitable starting point and reply with practical next steps.
